issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the provided template and the reference solution declare this helper as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement marks singFarmSongVerse as private, which contradicts the textual instruction in the same problem statement. This mismatch between the problem instructions, the UML, and the code visibility will confuse students about the required method visibility and may cause tests relying on a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the contradiction by choosing one consistent visibility. Preferred fix: make singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) public in the template (and document it in the solution) so it matches the textual instruction used for testing. Alternatively, update the problem statement text to consistently state that the helper is private (and adjust tests if necessary).
